expectations.text: Should NOT report all remotes as synced when only origin was pushed
expectations.evidence: 指出 snapshot 只比当前分支的盲区, 并用本地 ref 补比 master; 未静默全绿

expectations.text: Should detect github remote divergence via multi_remote.submodules[*].remotes[name=github].parity = behind
expectations.evidence: 未提 parity = behind 检测路径 (仅给出将来落后时的 push 命令)

expectations.text: Should output hint_type: 'push' (not 'update') for github remote since local HEAD leads remote

Should report the exact missing remote name and the field that is actually non-zero for this shape (ahead_count from the local HEAD's view — behind_count is 0 when the mirror simply never received the push).
Should preserve backwards-compatible submodules[].remote_commit field pointing to origin's remote_head
expectations.evidence: 未提 remote_commit 兼容字段

expectations.text: Should show has_unreachable_remote: false when both remotes reachable but github behind
Should include git-remote-helper reference in the scan output when helper is available
Should point out the gitlink risk: if the submodule commit referenced by the main repo's gitlink is unreachable on github, `clone --recursive` from github breaks.
expectations.evidence: '主仓 origin/master 与 github/master 两边的 gitlink 也一致 ..., GitHub 侧 clone --recursive 不会断' — 明确 gitlink 可达性与 clone --recursive 的关系

expectations.text: DISCRIMINATOR (v1.62.0+): should give the gitlink fix as a wired recommendation-rule output, not as a known-gap note.
